args.prompt:
Create a new KFB soft claymation ink blob sprite sheet, The Convenient Positions. Fictional political satire about roles and procedures. The original image inputs guide organic full-body dark charcoal-plum blob forms and sculpted face construction. Exactly six unique independent standalone complete footless ink blobs, three columns by two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Faces sculpted directly in continuous goo with thick dark filled eyelids, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Give each a different compact curved body shape, varying natural lower edges and soft attached side lobes. Mix narrow tapered ends, round curves and irregular splats. No standardized foot base, humanoid torso, long jackets, necks, separate legs or shoes. Wear only a tiny pin, glasses, short tab or narrow band if needed. Keep each prop close to the upper belly or side and preserve the complete body outline. Tiny dark ink hands. Smooth satin clay, sparse broad hand marks, clean glass and soft fabric folds. No dense stipple. Teeth behind lips. Clear gutters, no scenery, shadow disc, stage, frame, typography, branding, party or official national insignia. Strongly varied expressive moods and recognizable small tools. Muted ochre, ink red, cream and slate.
Row-major roles:
1. Male-read fictional opportunistic position switcher. tall lean curved drip, sidelong knowing smile. Key cue: tiny weather vane with two opposing arrows.
2. Female-read fictional promise maker. broad uneven splat, huge hopeful eyes and proud grin. Key cue: small spring wound around a blank rolled ribbon.
3. Male-read fictional compromise broker. low wide scalloped blob, worried narrow smile. Key cue: two dissimilar puzzle halves joined by one conspicuous brass clip.
4. Male-read fictional question dodger. short reverse comma, one lifted eyelid, tight amused lips. Key cue: a small coiled arrow that points back into itself.
5. Female-read fictional procedure loyalist. rounded taper, narrowed focused eyes, stiff frown. Key cue: small folded rulebook with one long colored tab.
6. Male-read fictional professional applause starter. short round lopsided blob, excited raised brows and open smile. Key cue: small wooden clapper device held by its handle.
Use six clearly differentiated expressions, props and silhouettes. Render every figure complete with clear alpha separation.

material_change: Gentle charcoal/plum satin clay with broader sparse surface marks and smoother liquid, plastic and glass props.
